title: luma rupestris
intro: Luma rupestris, commonly known as Chilean fir or Chilean luma, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Luma rupestris are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds, which may help to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and protect against oxidative stress. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Luma rupestris for medicinal use.
